prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for a detailed 16-bit pixel-art side-scrolling action game. Reference: user image robot black armor, exposed gold mechanical internals, amber round eyes and a luminous cracked ivory HEART-shaped chest core. Reimagine this robot as a towering enemy transformed from an armored semi-trailer, with heavy wheel assemblies in calves and back, folded cargo panels forming shoulders. NO human characters. Canvas 1536x1024, genuine transparent background. Layout THREE equal 512x1024 cells. Identical full-body robot facing left in three-quarter side view, feet at y950, top at y70, centered in each cell, never crossing cell boundaries. LEFT cell: fully standing, articulated chest armor OPEN with bright large cracked ivory heart at local x250,y400. MIDDLE cell: same pose and proportions, chest armor CLOSED over heart with two layered black-gold plates. RIGHT cell: intermediate transformation, crouched deeply with legs unfolding from truck wheel chassis, arms emerging from cargo panels, same design. High quality cohesive pixel rendering, amber rim lighting, dark gunmetal black plates, bronze/gold hydraulic details, mechanical joints, intimidating lean head matching reference. Small clean pixel clusters, sharp edges, no haze, no ground shadow, no text, no UI, no background. Full limbs intact. This is a new game asset, references guide design only.

Edit target: the attached robot sprite atlas. Remove ALL background and ALL brown/amber environmental haze around all three robots. Every pixel outside the hard mechanical silhouettes MUST be fully transparent alpha zero, including holes between arms and body, between legs, around cables. Do not paint a black, gray or checkerboard background. Preserve the robot artwork, positions, dimensions and pixel style exactly. No outside glow, no ground shadow, no ambient aura. This will be composited over a bright pink seaside background and any residual brown rectangle will be a defect. Output genuine RGBA PNG with clean isolated sprites.
